_comment: Tier-2: SurfaceLoadFromDEMCondition3D4N is not registered, so a hexahedral (quad-skin) structure cannot receive the DEM load — the structure must be meshed with tetrahedra. Pitfall (kratos.dem_structures_coupling #2). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv). With DemStructuresCouplingApplication imported, SurfaceLoadFromDEMCondition3D3N and LineLoadFromDEMCondition2D2N construct, while the 3D4N spelling raises RuntimeError 'The Condition "SurfaceLoadFromDEMCondition3D4N" is not registered!'. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics for real; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
